1	# Nova — Sprint 8 Competitor Benchmark: Artists / Team / Scheduling
2	
3	**Target:** InkOS — multi-user tattoo studio SaaS. Scope: staff artists, guest artists, shift grids, time-off, invites, permissions matrix.
4	**Benchmarked:** Rippling (HR/IT), Gusto (people/payroll), Linear (team pages), Notion (membership), Fresha + Mindbody (beauty scheduling), Porter/Mangomint (tattoo-specific).

8	## Part 1 — Team Member Roster
9	
10	### List view pattern
11	- **Rippling** uses a dense **table** (avatar, name, role, department, status, start date, manager). Virtualized, multi-column sort, saved views. Best for 50+ members.
12	- **Linear** uses a **hybrid table** — avatar + name + email + role column + joined date + last active. Sparse density, no specialty chips. Good reference for ≤30 members.
13	- **Gusto** uses a **card grid on mobile, table on desktop**. Card shows avatar, name, role, compensation summary on hover.
14	- **Fresha** uses **vertical cards with color accent** (artist's assigned calendar color) — works because beauty studios are small (5–15 team members).
15	
16	**InkOS recommendation:** Table view primary (like Rippling) because studios hit 10–25 members with commissions. Add a **toggle** to "Cards" for smaller studios or mobile. Columns: Avatar · Name · Role (chip) · Specialty (chip list) · Status · Commission % · Next shift · Actions.
17	
18	### Filters
19	- Rippling uses **filter chips above the table** (Role, Status, Department, Location, Manager) with a "+ Add filter" button for custom fields.
20	- Linear uses **a single search bar + role dropdown**. Under-powered for InkOS.
21	- **InkOS filters:** Role (Owner/Artist/Receptionist/Guest), Status (Active/Inactive/Pending invite/On leave), Specialty (Black & Grey / Color / Realism / Traditional / Piercing), Availability today (toggle).
22	
23	### Profile page
24	Strongest template is **Gusto's employee profile**: left rail with avatar + name + role + "Message" CTA; right pane with tabs (Overview, Compensation, Time Off, Documents, Notes).
25	
26	**InkOS artist profile tabs:**
27	1. **Overview** — hero (avatar + name + role + status + specialties + Instagram link); stats grid (appointments this month, revenue YTD, avg rating, no-show rate, commission earned MTD)
28	2. **Schedule** — mini week view, next 5 bookings
29	3. **Portfolio** — 3×3 photo grid (most recent tattoo photos from completed bookings — auto-populated from client session photos with artist tag, gated by consent)
30	4. **Commission & Payroll** — current rate, YTD earnings, next payout
31	5. **Documents** — contractor agreement, W-9, licenses, insurance
32	6. **Permissions** — read-only view of their role + link to edit
33	
34	### Portfolio/examples
35	Fresha shows artist photos as **a horizontal carousel under the profile header** — this is the strongest pattern for a scheduling-heavy tool because the user lands for scheduling but sees portfolio instantly. Mangomint uses a dedicated "Portfolio" tab. Notion/Linear don't ship this. Copy Fresha carousel + Mangomint tab separation.

39	## Part 2 — Shift Scheduling Grid
40	
41	### Grid layout
42	- **Fresha** — **artists as columns (vertical), time as rows**. Day view default, week view as toggle. 15-min slot granularity. Colored blocks span time ranges. Drag edges to extend. Drag block body to reassign artist or move time.
43	- **Mindbody** — same vertical-columns layout, but week view shows **multi-day resource schedule** (each artist gets a sub-column per day).
44	- **Rippling** — **horizontal rows = people, columns = days**, designed for shift blocks not appointments. Simpler, less granular (no 15-min slots).
45	
46	**InkOS recommendation:** **Fresha-style vertical artist columns + time rows** for the day view (this is where bookings happen). Add a **"Shift schedule" toggle** that flips to Rippling-style horizontal rows × days for weekly shift planning (no appointments, just availability windows). Two modes, one grid component.
47	
48	### Drag-assign
49	Fresha's drag model is the gold standard — click-hold a booking block → drag vertically to change time, drag horizontally to change artist. Ghost preview shows new slot before commit. **Must-have for InkOS.**
50	
51	Rippling's shift assignment uses a simpler **"click empty cell → pick shift template → apply"** flow. Copy this for empty-shift creation; use Fresha's drag for moving.
52	
53	### Templates
54	- Fresha — **"Working hours templates"** saved per artist (e.g. "Tuesday–Saturday 11am–8pm"). Apply on hire.
55	- Rippling — **"Shift patterns"** at team level; assign patterns to employees.
56	- **InkOS:** Per-artist default template (their weekly availability) + per-studio "week template" (staffing pattern: how many artists on each day/shift). One-click "Apply template to next 4 weeks".
57	
58	### Copy previous week
59	Rippling and Mindbody both ship **"Copy from last week"** as a single button in the week header. Fresha has **"Duplicate week"** in the overflow menu. Put this button front-and-center in InkOS — studios are repetitive.
60	
61	### Time-off overlay
62	Fresha uses a **diagonal-stripe texture with muted gray fill** for time-off blocks (distinguishes from bookings and blocked time). Mindbody uses a **solid red tint**. Stripe pattern wins — it's clearly "not bookable" without screaming. **Adopt Fresha's diagonal-stripe pattern.**

66	## Part 3 — Time-Off / Requests
67	
68	### Request form
69	Gusto's PTO request is the cleanest: **date range picker (calendar), reason dropdown (Vacation/Sick/Personal/Bereavement/Other), optional note, "Submit to manager" button**. Submitted requests appear in a "Pending" section on the requester's profile.
70	
71	**InkOS form:** date range, reason (Vacation / Sick / Personal / Conference / Other), note, attach doctor's note (optional file), submit.
72	
73	### Approval flow
74	- **Gusto** — manager gets email + in-app notification; one-click Approve/Deny from notification. Slack/Teams integration optional.
75	- **Rippling** — approval chain (configurable: manager → HR → exec for >5 days).
76	- **Fresha** — studio owner approves; no chain.
77	
78	**InkOS:** Studio owner + anyone with `schedule.manage` permission can approve. Single-step (no chains in v1). Email + in-app notification with Approve/Deny CTAs. Slack integration deferred to v2.
79	
80	### Conflict detection
81	**Critical feature — nobody ships this well.** Fresha warns at submission time "⚠ You have 3 bookings during this period". Mindbody doesn't block but surfaces the conflict count.
82	
83	**InkOS:** At request submission **and** at approval, show a red banner: "X bookings + Y consultations scheduled during this time-off." Provide action links: "Reassign to another artist" or "Contact clients to reschedule". Block approval until conflicts are either resolved or explicitly acknowledged ("Approve anyway").

87	## Part 4 — Guest Artists
88	
89	Guest artists are a tattoo-industry-specific workflow. Porter + Mangomint are the only platforms that handle this natively. Fresha handles it via a generic "guest pro" user type; Rippling/Gusto don't have it.
90	
91	### Sponsor/host flow
92	**Porter** model: host artist sends an invite → guest fills form (name, Instagram, portfolio link, licenses, dates, revenue split) → host approves → guest gets booking calendar for their residency window only. This is the **Airbnb host + event-guest model** — guest has their own calendar scoped to the dates.
93	
94	**InkOS:** Copy Porter's flow. "Invite guest artist" wizard (3 steps: Identity → Residency dates → Commission split). Host artist is auto-assigned as sponsor and sees guest's bookings in their dashboard.
95	
96	### Engagement periods
97	Porter uses **start date + end date on the guest profile**; bookings outside the window are blocked automatically. Fresha uses **a "travel dates" field** but doesn't enforce it in the calendar.
98	
99	**InkOS:** Hard-enforce engagement window. Guest artist disappears from the booking dropdown after end date. Add **a 7-day extension flow** (one click, no re-onboarding).
100	
101	### Revenue split
102	- **Porter** — **three modes**: percentage split (e.g. 70/30 artist/studio), flat daily rent (e.g. $200/day guest pays studio), hybrid (flat rent + smaller %).
103	- **Mangomint** — percentage only.
104	- **Keep The Fees** — per-service percentages.
105	
106	**InkOS:** Ship all three (percentage, flat daily, hybrid). Commission calc runs per-booking and feeds the payroll module (Sprint 8 connects to Sprint 8's payroll piece already spec'd).
